title: A Decentralized Retrieval Augmented Generation System with Source Reliabilities Secured on Blockchain
authors: Yining Lu; Wenyi Tang; Max Johnson; Taeho Jung; Meng Jiang
why_relevant: Proposes a source reliability scoring mechanism for decentralized RAG to handle unreliable data sources with varying quality (noise, misinformation, outdated content).
why_not_or_caveat: Primary focus is decentralized architecture and blockchain-based trust management, not robustness methodology per se; relevance to robust RAG is tangential.
